why: The gallery declares itself a test level while it carries `design.json`, the approved design record step 4 wrote. A test level is a level built to try something with no approved design; a level with an approved design is not one, so the two are two authorities for one design and `DW1061` refuses the pair at validate, naming both ways out. The other half — `test_level: true` with no record builds, carries `test_level: true` in its manifest and moves no emitted byte — has no subject on the gallery, which ships its design record, and is proven by `crates/delvec/tests/test_level.rs`.
